questions.cardText:
[Art History] What was the first fresco painting that Michelangelo created?
A. The Last Judgment
B. The Doni Tondo
C. The Sistine Chapel Ceiling
Answer: C. Michelangelo initially resisted the commission because he had never done a fresco painting before and considered himself a sculptor rather than a painter.
questions.de: Welchen Freskoauftrag, gemalt von 1508 bis 1512, übernahm Michelangelo widerwillig als sein erstes großes Fresko, da er sich eher als Bildhauer denn als Maler sah?
questions.en: Which fresco commission, painted from 1508 to 1512, did Michelangelo reluctantly take on as his first major fresco, considering himself a sculptor rather than a painter?

timeline.labelEn: Michelangelo paints the Sistine Chapel ceiling in fresco for Pope Julius II
timeline.labelDe: Michelangelo malt im Auftrag von Papst Julius II. die Decke der Sixtinischen Kapelle in Fresko

questions.notes: Card overstated: Wikipedia says Bramante doubted Michelangelo could take on so large a fresco 'as he had limited experience in the medium' — not none; he had trained in Domenico Ghirlandaio's fresco workshop and his Battle of Cascina fresco (1504) was never painted beyond the cartoon. The ceiling (1508–1512) is his first major fresco; the Doni Tondo is a panel painting and the Last Judgment came later (1536–1541). Asked as his first major fresco.

questions.cardText:
[Physics] What property of a sound wave is primarily responsible for determining its timbre, allowing us to distinguish between different instruments playing the same note?
A. Amplitude
B. Waveform
C. Frequency
Answer: B. On the topic of sound, a clap of thunder is actually a shock wave created by the rapid expansion of air heated by a lightning bolt.
questions.de: Welche Eigenschaft einer Schallwelle, bestimmt durch ihre Mischung von Obertönen, ist vor allem für ihre Klangfarbe verantwortlich, sodass wir verschiedene Instrumente unterscheiden, die denselben Ton spielen?
questions.en: What property of a sound wave, set by its mix of overtones, is primarily responsible for its timbre, letting us tell apart different instruments playing the same note?

timeline.labelEn: Hermann von Helmholtz publishes On the Sensations of Tone, a foundational work on music acoustics
timeline.labelDe: Hermann von Helmholtz veröffentlicht „Die Lehre von den Tonempfindungen“, ein Grundlagenwerk der musikalischen Akustik

questions.notes: Card correct; its explanation (thunder as a shock wave) is unrelated to the question. Wikipedia (Timbre): the physical characteristics governing timbre are the frequency spectrum and envelope; ANSI: timbre depends primarily on the frequency spectrum. Timeline: Helmholtz, who named timbre Klangfarbe; Sensations of Tone first published 1863 (Wikipedia: On the Sensations of Tone).
